events.title: German Stocks Extending Recent Gains
events.description: German stocks gained notable ground in positive territory Monday morning, extending gains from the previous session, amid easing geopolitical tensions after U.S. President Donald Trump's comments that there won't be any military action against Iran before the midterm elections in the U.S.

events.title: Oil Prices Rise In Choppy Trade
events.description: Oil prices traded higher on Monday, recouping early losses in the wake of fresh attacks on Saudi Arabia's aviation infrastructure by Iran-backed Houthi militants and a drone strike on a tanker near the Sohar anchorage off Oman.

events.title: European Shares Edge Higher As Bond Yields Fall
events.description: European stocks traded higher on Monday, after having recovered from four-month lows in the previous session on U.S. President Trump's remarks dismissing speculation of pre-midterm military action against Iran.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed In Cautious Trade
events.description: Asian stocks turned in a mixed performance on Monday, with South Korean markets falling sharply due to worsening investor sentiment in the semiconductor sector on growing concerns over the AI industry in the U.S.

events.title: Canadian Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Canadian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Monday.

events.title: European Shares Seen Up As Inflation Concerns Ease
events.description: European stocks are seen opening higher on Monday as investors monitor the situation in oil markets and await cues from the third-quarter U.S. earnings season.

events.title: Indian Shares Fluctuate In Range-bound Trade
events.description: Indian shares were fluctuating in early trade on Monday as investors monitored developments in energy markets and reacted to the Reserve Bank of India's latest measures to support the plunging rupee.

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is extending its early gains in mid-market trading on Monday, adding to the gains in the previous session, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street on Friday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is moving well above the 8,750.00 level, with gains across most sectors led by mining and technology stocks. Energy stocks are the only weak spot.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mixed
events.description: Asian markets are mixed on Monday, following the positive cues from Wall Street on Friday, as traders remain cautious about the developments in the Middle East as US President Donald trump said he may join Saudi Arabia in retaliating against Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen following another deadly attack on Riyadh's international airport and tanker attacks near the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Higher At Open After Trump's Russia Diesel Deal
events.description: Indian shares look set to open higher on Monday as a U.S.-Russia deal on 500,000 metric tons of fuel to reach international markets cast doubt on the likelihood of the White House imposing new sanctions on Russia.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May Add To Its Winnings On Monday
events.description: The Thai stock market bounced higher again on Friday, one day after ending the five-day winning streak in which it had gained almost 25 points or 1.6 percent. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,575-point plateau and it's looking at another solid lead for Monday's trade.

events.title: Higher Open Called For Indonesia Stock Market
events.description: The Indonesia stock market on Friday ended the two-day losing streak in which it had lost more than 160 points or 2.5 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just shy of the 6,100-point plateau and it's likely to see additional support on Monday.

events.title: Hong Kong Shares Poised To Open To The Upside On Monday
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market on Friday halted the two-day slide in which it had fallen almost 500 points or 2 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,200-point plateau and it's tipped to open in the green again on Monday.
